_about: F64 THE FINAL SHIFT (rank 50, the boss level — design/story.md 'The final shift'). All goop and every crack is one colour (galaxy black): any goop merges with any, any goop seals any crack. Goop falls faster and more often, Management's pressure climbs faster, the Veteran (the white goop) drops in first and seals the cracks you can't reach — losing a little of himself with each. Seals (his too) count toward 3 release-valve stages; while a stage waits for you at the console, seals don't count. Lose: he's used up · goop over the top · integrity 0 (each ends the shift at once). Win: the third stage opened. Read by the engine (src/engine/shift.ts, finalShift.ts) at the moment each number is used, on the rules clock — live in the Dev Kit. Times in seconds.

_help.rank: The final shift is played at this rank (50 = the top rank, progression.json maxRank).
_help.colour: The one colour every goop and crack has in the final shift (a name from shift.json colors — 'black', the 7th, arrives only here).
_help.fallSpeedMult: Pieces fall this many times faster than in any other shift (fast drop too). 1 = the normal speed.
_help.pressureRiseMult: Pressure climbs this many times faster ('PRESSURE INCREASED 400%'). 1 = the normal rise (shift.json pressure.riseMsToFull).
_help.crackRateMult: Cracks form this many times as often at the same pressure. 1 = the normal rate.
_help.rain.everySec: Extra goop: every this many seconds a few loose cells rain in at the top of random columns (on top of the pieces). 0 = no rain.
_help.rain.cells: How many cells each rain brings.
_help.valve.stages: Seals needed for each release-valve stage, in order (Muzzy 2026-10-23: 6 / 8 / 10 to start). A grown crack counts its cell count, as everywhere. Seals past a stage's number are lost; seals while a stage waits at the console don't count.
_help.vet.sealTime: The Veteran in the final shift: seconds sitting on a crack to seal it (whiteGoop.json sealTime is 6 in other shifts — here he's efficient).
_help.vet.secPerCell: His ooze speed here: seconds per cell through empty tank.
_help.vet.restAfter: His rest after each seal here (seconds).
_help.vet.dropSecPerCell: How fast he falls in at the start (seconds per row) — like a falling piece.
_help.vet.targetBy: Which cracks he goes for here: outOfReach = only cracks you can't reach (at least reachRows empty rows under them in their column), the hardest first; with none, he waits. (Other choices as whiteGoop.json.)
_help.vet.reachRows: outOfReach: a crack with at least this many empty rows under it (rows you'd have to build up to cover it) counts as out of your reach.
_help.vet.countsForQuota: His seals count toward the valve stages here (true, as when F64 was approved) — other shifts' quota leaves them out (whiteGoop.json countsForQuota false, F52).
_help.vet.shrinkPerSeal: How much of himself he loses per crack cell he seals (1 = all of him). 0.1 = used up after 10 seals — and that's a loss.
_help.intro.hiSec: The drop-in: seconds after the shift opens that he says 'oh! hi!' (he's at the top of the tank, about to fall).
_help.intro.fallSec: …then he falls (seconds after the shift opens).
_help.intro.helpSec: Seconds after he lands ('…oof.') that he says 'glad you're not goop yet. I'll help how I can.'
_help.intro.playSec: Seconds after he lands that the first piece comes in and the shift's clock starts (pressure, cracks). Until then everything waits.
_help.intro.lineSec: How long each of his lines stays in its bubble (looks time).
_help.consoleTimeScale: How fast the final shift runs while you're at the console (where its valve stages open): 0.25 = a quarter speed. Other shifts use breakdowns.json consoleTimeScale (0.75); Focus Mode slows both. Muzzy 2026-10-30 (F52): the final shift keeps the 25% it was approved with.
_help.bots.valveSec: Balance bots only (scripts/bots): a valve stage stands in as this many seconds at the console, where the shift runs at breakdowns.json consoleTimeScale — until Muzzy's valve mini-game (task 5) is built.
